title: Barcelona walking tour
text: Family of 5 walking tour of Barcelona El Borne and Gothic Quarter with guide Fabio. Really enjoyed the experience and Fabio was excellent in explaining all the history and details, even providing directions for food and entertainment after the tour was complete. We wish all the guides could be like Fabio, would highly recommend!
author: Jack_M

title: Best of Barcelona in a Day!
text: It's a fantastic walking tour you get to see the Born district, gothic quarter and many sights in Barcelona, Fabio really cares to make it a great experience for his clients and is flexible with stops and even sights to see. Highly recommend this tour if your in Barcelona!
author: Elizabeth_B

title: Fabulous Barcelona Tour with Fabio
text: Our tour guide, Fabio, provided a memorable experience - full of knowledge and passion about Barcelona, we learned much and also had a fun day together.   This was our second tour visit with Fabio.  Flexible, kind and professional tour guide.
author: angelabV6979KN

title: Absolutely Wonderful 3 Hour Private Tour.  You Will Love This Town Walk With Fabio.  Very Interesting & A Lot of Fun.
text: Three hours walking the old town with Fabio was the nicest part of my week in Barcelona, and I saw and did a lot while there.  It is an amazing city and Fabio's warm and pleasant manner will make sure you see the best of this historic and culturally rich city with its charming people.  Fabio is extremely knowledgeable about the history, geography and cultural richness of Barcelona, plus he's a lot of fun to spend time with touring the town.  I highly recommend this tour with Fabio.  You won't be disappointed!
author: KarenB165

title: Superb Barcelona Tour with a Great Guide!
text: I decided to book a 3-hour tour to discover all the faces of Barcelona. I did not see the hours pass. This Fabio Guide is just great. With him we really appreciate the city of Barcelona, with its ancient and sometimes painful history, tasty anecdotes and visits to neighborhoods often forgotten (wrongly) by tourists. Fabio is exciting in his comments without being heavy like some guides. It also brings surprising anecdotes and humor. He loves this city and this 3-hour tour explains why. One almost has the Impression that it is a friend who shows his city around. Nice service to discover Barcelo
author: Jean-François D

title: A fun friendly and informative tour
text:
Intelligent informative and caring tour guide.  Most importantly- engaging.
Book the tour- you won’t regret it! 
We booked Fabio’s tour  after much research . We decided to risk it even though no/few reviews- and it was a great find! Even though several places were closed due to the June holiday Fabio  made the tour interesting . Also great that it was private- just our family and not a group of 20.  Very  easy to converse and move around

And BTW - excellent English and he speaks several languages
author: motherknitter82
